What BikeShop Manager does

Everything a two-wheeler shop's day needs

From a customer's booking to the worker's salary, in one system.

Online booking

Customers see the shop's services and offers, and book a service in under a minute — no app or sign-up needed.

Job work-cards

Create a job, assign a worker, and track it through the work: services, materials and labour, with a live bill.

Customers & bikes

Each customer can have multiple bikes, each with its own full service history — no more searching paper records.

Suppliers & expenses

Track material dues by supplier, and settle them weekly or monthly, alongside the shop's other expenses.

Worker attendance & salary

Workers mark their own attendance; salary is calculated automatically, with pending-days tracking and UPI pay.

Everything dynamic

Shop info, services, prices, categories, job statuses, material types and workers — all set from Settings, nothing hardcoded.

Built for three kinds of user

Customer, owner, and worker — each with their own screen

Public websiteHome, services & pricing, offers, online booking and a floating WhatsApp button. No login needed.
Admin panelDashboard, jobs board, job details with materials and labour, billing, customers, suppliers, offers and settings.
Worker panelMobile-first: today's assigned jobs, attendance, salary (pending amount and days) with UPI pay, and payment history.
A job, start to finish

From booking to bill

Book or walk in

A customer books online, or simply brings the bike in. Either way, a job work-card is created.

Assign and work

A worker is assigned; services, materials (with supplier) and labour are added as the work happens.

Bill it

The live bill updates as items are added, so the total is never a surprise at hand-over.

Pay the worker

Attendance and job completions roll up into the worker's salary, with pending amount shown and UPI pay.

Questions

Good to know

Does a customer need an app to book?

No. Booking is a simple web form on the shop's own website — no install, no account.

Can I track which worker did a job?

Yes. Every job work-card is assigned to a worker, and the worker panel shows their own assigned jobs.

How does billing work?

Services, materials and labour are added to the job as work happens, and the bill is live — no separate billing step.

How is salary calculated?

From attendance and completed work, with the pending amount and pending-since days shown, and a UPI pay option with a PIN confirm.

Can I change services, prices and categories myself?

Yes, from Settings — nothing is hardcoded. Services, categories, job statuses, material types and workers are all yours to edit.

Which languages does it support?

English, Tamil and Telugu, easily extended.
